candidates.change_summary: Replaced owner-only require check with no check and assign totalDistributed to caller (msg.sender) instead of owner, so calling XBornID sets balances[msg.sender] = totalDistributed rather than balances[owner].
Change transferFrom to NOT decrement allowed[_from][msg.sender], leaving allowance unchanged after transferFrom.
Change transferFrom to set allowed[_from][msg.sender] to zero after a transfer, clearing the allowance regardless of amount.
Change onlyPayloadSize to require exact (not at least) data length, which can permit or reject some calls and thus change whether transferFrom executes and mutates allowance.
